A neat SHORT black pixie haircut with tapered sides and a low, lightly textured top, feminine and practical, forehead and eyes clearly visible. No badges or logos, no weapons, no hands or props in the crop.

Match the reference's square head-and-shoulders avatar scale and upper-chest crop. Hair entirely inside frame, around 8–10 percent safety margin above hair and beside head, eyes/nose mask area centered for circular and rounded-square crops.
Background: completely OPAQUE, solid vivid royal BLUE (target #175FE8) from edge to edge and in all four corners. The Manager's assigned background is blue, not the reference's magenta. No scenery, gradient, pattern, halo, circle or vignette.

Sculpted human facial planes, natural skin, tactile dark fabrics, accurately shaded metal, warm neutral key lighting with subtle cool rim light, sharp features and clean continuous silhouette. Mature cyberpunk, never cute/chibi/anime.
Important: absolutely NO glitch effects, floating cubes, shards, image slicing, channel offsets, doubled outlines or digital distortion. Physical implant indicator lights are allowed. No text, frame, watermark, extra panels, characters or accessories.
